sys_hub_flow.description: Triggered when a Training Enrollment record is deleted. If the enrollment state was not Reproved, meaning the flow had not already decremented the seat count, this flow decrements the occupied_seats field of the related Training Schedule by 1, keeping seat availability accurate.
